v44 GT audit - exact-GT arenas judged WRONG
These four arenas have exact GT (bbox or count) and use the official rule verbatim (OSWorldG evaluator: first predicted point inside the box). Shown are cases judged WRONG so the GT itself can be audited. Green = GT box/points with solid guide lines; red cross with dashed guide lines = model answer. Right image crops to contain both. If the model looks right in many of these, that arena has label noise.
